answer: Entry needs a priced attestation: a new identity entering through an inlet must be attested by an established identity paying a copper fee on the basalt ledger. The fee is quadratic: the k-th attestation costs k squared credits; the 10th costs 100, the 100th 10,000. Attesting 1,000 fakes from one identity costs 333,833,500 credits, or 3,383,500 split across 10 attestors; one honest attestation costs 1. The basalt ledger publishes each count, so anyone can recompute the fee. A rented-attestor ring fails: rented attestations pile onto the same counter at the same price.
